note: Enntity/atlas inkling2/mini-20261121: the Inkling 2 Mini (model type inkling2_loop) serving series, 28 commits on Atlas-Inf main 269b533bc (Merge #332). It parses the checkpoint as 48 unrolled layer visits, checks its layout at load, and adds the inkling-2-mini kernel target: decode attention with relative bias and per-token sinks, short convolutions, block attention residuals, loop message gates, NVFP4 and MXFP8 stacked-expert MoE decode and grouped-GEMM prefill, tensor-core prefill attention, CUDA-graph single-sequence decode, the Spark NVFP4 overlay (attention projections, the experts of layers 20-23, lm_head) and decode batches that read each expert once. No DSpark drafter and no vision tower yet. Not proposed upstream yet; re-pinned before the first release.
